story.en: TODO(verify): The image of Our Lady of Peñafrancia leaves Danlugan ni Ina on a pagoda barge, towed by voyadores in paddle boats, and goes up the Naga River to near the Peñafrancia Basilica. The route is from the project owner and needs a published source; the date and times are placeholders.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap
sources.note: Locations and names only: Danlugan ni Ina (node/6791580317) and the Peñafrancia Basilica (way/23670362). The route between them, the schedule, and the formation are unsourced.
